responsibility: Executes one declared verification of model-authored source in the sealed nonroot contained worker and returns the result through the Layer-2 execution port.
reads: the token-covered ExecutionRequest supplied through cis.execution.port
the worker evidence file the sealed container writes to its own workspace
execution_location: host container runtime, invoking a sealed nonroot image
failure_boundary: fail_closed - an unverified token, an undeclared operation, an empty allowed scope, an absent source, absent vectors or an absent entrypoint refuses before any container starts, and a worker that produces no evidence is reported as HARNESS_FAILURE rather than as any statement about the source
recovery_behavior: Each dispatch is independent and writes no authority: a private temporary contract and workspace directory is created and removed on every path including failure, the container runs with --rm, and recovery is a fresh authorization rather than a retry of a spent one. A container timeout is reported as RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION infrastructure rather than as a source verdict
replacement_contract: A replacement must accept the same ExecutionRequest, preserve the worker's six-argument frozen invocation, apply the same closed verdict mapping in which only SOURCE_PASS yields status completed with exit code zero, write no evidence of its own, and leave backend_runs and evidence_records recording entirely to cis.execution.gateway
evidence_produced: verdict and classification naming SOURCE_PASS, SOURCE_FAIL, HARNESS_FAILURE or RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION
source_sha256 of the exact model-authored artifact executed
vector_contract_sha256 of the exact declared test-vector contract
task_contract_bundle_sha256 and authorization_binding_hash binding the run to its authorization
trusted_runner_sha256 and worker_sha256 attesting the exact bytes that produced the verdict
